title: Phase 5 decision memo (applies the frozen rule reanalysis/rule_frozen.yaml)

provenance.label_convention: Per main.tex line 128 (Eq.8): REPLAY = mechanical per-turn reduction at FIXED trajectory length (turns * dOcc); TRAJECTORY = change in total turns (dTurns * Occ). Eqs 4-7 derive only the replay component.

primary_outcome.estimand: E1 rtk x compaction, per-turn PT interaction Y11-Y10-Y01+Y00
primary_outcome.verdict: includes zero -> null; interval is WIDE relative to the estimate (CI/|estimate| ~17), not a precise null
primary_outcome.branch_taken: primary_ci_includes_zero -> honest null; and per significance_audit_GOVERNING, ALL token-outcome contrasts are underpowered, so the paper becomes taxonomy + accounting framework + methodological pilot (see honest_paper_framing)

calibration_eq5_3x_RETRACTED.status: RETRACTED (5th). The '3.05x over-prediction' was not established.
calibration_eq5_3x_RETRACTED.why: The observed RTK effect on PT (compaction off) is -3,544 with a task-seed block-bootstrap 95% CI of [-28,419, +22,808] (t~-0.2): NOT distinguishable from zero. The Eq.5 prediction of -15,251 sits INSIDE that CI, so the data cannot distinguish 'model over-predicts 3.05x' from 'model is exactly right' from 'RTK does nothing'. A ratio of two point estimates was reported without propagating uncertainty. What would have falsified 'the model over-predicts'? The prediction landing inside the observed CI - which is what happened.
calibration_eq5_3x_RETRACTED.root_cause: Same structural error as the prior four, new costume: a well-measured input (tool output -60%, retention 0.99, turns flat) used to make a precise prediction of an UNMEASURABLE target (cumulative PT, per-cell SD ~62,709 ~= mean ~58,885).

significance_audit_GOVERNING.result: 3 of 36 contrasts are distinguishable from zero, and all three are DIRECT mechanical effects (near-tautological), not compositional or downstream:

rtk_main::total_tool_output_tokens.meaning: RTK reduces tool output (its direct target)

significance_audit_GOVERNING.NOT_distinguishable: RTK->PT (-3544, CI crosses 0), RTK->GT, compaction->GT, ALL interactions (pt/gt/per-turn/turns), turns, and everything in E2. The compositional/interaction question the paper actually asks is unanswerable at n=12.
significance_audit_GOVERNING.honest_reading: RTK measurably compresses its direct target (tool output) but this does NOT produce a detectable change in cumulative PT or GT - because cumulative-token variance swamps it. That IS the editor's variance point, demonstrated. No token-outcome headline (3.05x, generation offset, RTK main effect on PT) is supported at this sample size.
significance_audit_GOVERNING.protocol_cost: To detect the Eq.5-predicted RTK PT effect (~15k) at pooled SD ~62,709 needs ~265 runs/cell (80% power); the observed effect would need ~4,900/cell. Current n=12/cell. This required-sample-size number is itself a methodological deliverable.

normalisation_units_not_precision.finding: Dividing PT by turns (mean turns ~32) rescales BOTH the estimate and the CI by ~32, so relative precision CI/|estimate| is UNCHANGED (16.8 vs 17.0). An earlier version of this memo claimed '~32x precision / uninformative -> precise null'; that was WRONG - a units change, not a precision gain (variance_gain 1014 = 31.86^2, the squared units factor). The editor's specific remedy (normalise by turns) does NOT tighten inference for this dataset because turn counts barely vary across cells (turns interaction +1.33, CI [-8.3,+12.2], null); the imprecision is genuine between-task/between-run per-turn-occupancy dispersion, which normalisation cannot remove. The revision should say this plainly, using the decomposition as support.

oaxaca_eq8_e1.status: DESCRIPTIVE ATTRIBUTION ONLY - not a model test. Eq.8 is an algebraic identity that sums to dPT for any dataset; the 98.3%/2.9% split verifies arithmetic (frac_sum_check=1.0), not the recurrence theory. It says WHERE the saving sits, not whether the model predicted it. The model test is calibration_eq5_test above.

full_composition_Y00_to_Y11.note: confounds both factors; shown for the total effect only

rtk_at_compaction_on_Y01_to_Y11.caveat: small denominator (-2095 PT) makes percentages unstable

oaxaca_eq8_e1.interpretation: The PT saving is driven by COMPACTION (delta_pt -22k to -25k), ~90-100% through the replay (per-turn) channel. RTK's own effect is small (-2k to -5k). The interaction (does RTK modify compaction's effect) is the null above.

turns_interaction_e1.verdict: null; trajectory length ~18-19 turns in every cell (why the trajectory term is small)

e2_gt_per_turn_interaction_DESCRIPTIVE.caveat: descriptive only; degeneracy + gt=11 collapse contamination

supporting_results.degeneracy_diagnostic: 104/144 E2 runs (72%) are process-degenerate (temperature-0.2 duplicate/trivial trajectories); a reusable measurement artifact, framed as supporting (AI Agents That Matter 2407.01502 critiques eval design but does not provide this per-run determinism/duplication filter).

errata_and_corrections.generation_offset_mechanism_DEMOTED: The replacement claim ('Eq.5 over-predicts because compression is 68% offset by increased generation') was itself unsupported: Delta gt = +973, SE 1288, t 0.76, 95% CI [-1693,+3638] - null at n=12. Demoted from finding to candidate HYPOTHESIS. The tool+gen reconstruction (0.97x) is an accounting identity (exhaustive by construction), relabelled as a completeness check, not validation. Fourth unsupported claim caught pre-submission. (The 3.05x Eq.5 over-prediction that this erratum once called the surviving headline was ITSELF retracted next - see calibration_3.05x_overprediction_RETRACTED.) Gate reaffirmed: apply the falsifiability test to each REPLACEMENT claim, not only the retracted one.
errata_and_corrections.oaxaca_confirms_model_claim_RETRACTED: A prior version said the a priori replay model is confirmed because the Oaxaca split attributes 98.3% to replay. RETRACTED as circular: Eq.8 is an identity (sums to dPT for any data), so 98.3% tests arithmetic against itself, and the paper itself calls Eq.8 'decomposed conceptually' (a definition, not a prediction). The falsifiable content is in Eqs 4-7; the honest test (calibration_eq5) shows Eq.5 OVER-predicts 3.05x. Third circular claim caught pre-submission (after the 32x and this); standing rule now: for every claim, ask what result would have falsified it - if nothing would, it is not a finding.
errata_and_corrections.estimator_efficiency_claim_RETRACTED: A prior version claimed per-turn normalisation gives ~32x precision / variance ~1000x, converting an uninformative interval into a precise null. RETRACTED: the 32x is mean turns (a units rescale); relative precision CI/|estimate| is unchanged (16.76 raw vs 16.95 per-turn, ratio 1.01x). The variance_gain 1014 was just 31.86^2. The claim contradicted our own null turns interaction (dividing by a near-constant cannot remove variance). D-prime rests on the calibration result alone.
errata_and_corrections.calibration_3.05x_overprediction_RETRACT: The '3.05x over-prediction' headline (itself the replacement for the retracted 98.3% claim) was not established: the observed RTK PT effect is -3,544 with 95% CI [-28,419,+22,808] (null), and the Eq.5 prediction -15,251 sits inside that CI. Fifth retraction. Governing evidence: significance_audit (3/36 contrasts distinguishable, all direct-mechanical). Structural lesson now explicit: do not build any claim whose TARGET is cumulative PT/GT at n=12 - that target's SD ~= its mean. The paper's empirical headline must be dropped.
errata_and_corrections.oaxaca_label_swap_fixed: An earlier run reported '98% per-turn / 3% replay', naming the per-turn component twice, and had the JSON keys backwards (replay_term_dturns_x_occ / per_turn_term_turns_x_docc). Corrected per Eq.8: REPLAY = turns*dOcc (98.3%), TRAJECTORY = dturns*Occ (2.9%), remainder -1.3%, sum 100%. Keys are now replay_term_turns_x_docc / trajectory_term_dturns_x_occ. The math was always right; only the names were wrong.
errata_and_corrections.e2_collider_CONFIRMED: Degeneracy by arm: Y00 24/36 (67%), Y10 24/36 (67%), Y01 28/36 (78%), Y11 28/36 (78%). Perfectly arm-consistent, 11 points higher in BOTH CoD cells, in exactly the direction Table 1 predicts for CoD's zero-shot-collapse failure mode. This is treatment-induced, not noise; filtering E2 to get the interaction is post-treatment conditioning on a collider. (An interim note comparing against the ~26/cell average mistakenly read this as balance; the correct comparison is the arm contrast, and the frozen YAML's collider basis stands.)
errata_and_corrections.e1_primacy_robust_grounds: E1 is the primary on grounds that survive scrutiny: (a) zero process-degenerate runs, no filtering needed, (b) full 12 runs and six distinct tasks per cell, (c) PT is the exact outcome the editor objected to; and independently, E2's interaction requires collider-inducing filtering. E2 remains descriptive.

limitations_to_state_in_paper.block_bootstrap_12_blocks: The primary CI is a task-seed block bootstrap over only n_blocks=12 (6 tasks x 2 seeds). Block bootstrap coverage with so few blocks is known to be anti-conservative, so the [-1467, +1582] interval is probably slightly NARROWER than nominal. This does not threaten the null (a wider interval still spans zero) but must be stated as a limitation rather than left for a reviewer, and it argues against over-precise claims about the magnitude.
limitations_to_state_in_paper.seed_expansion_underdelivered: The 2->6 seed expansion was described as a deliberate power decision, but at temperature 0.2 it delivered ~1 extra distinct trajectory per cell, not 4: E1 (2 seeds) = 2.0 distinct/cell (100%), E2 (6 seeds) = 2.9 distinct/cell. Seeds mostly reproduced duplicates. The revision must say this plainly and is why Option B needs more TASKS, not more seeds.

paper_must_fix_from_corpus_gate: Relabel SAC as cost-of-pass v=C/R and cite arXiv:2504.13359 (+ Efficient Agents 2508.02694, AI Agents That Matter 2407.01502).

Add ACON (2510.00615), AgentDiet (2509.23586), LightThinker++ (2604.03679, PRE-freeze prior art) to the taxonomy; re-scope C1 to an honest narrow claim (no strict two-method cross-category composition with individual baselines found), not a headline gap.

Cite arXiv:2607.12161 generously and state its date plainly: posted 2026-07-14, one day before our 2026-07-15 hypothesis freeze. Technically prior by a day; we could not have incorporated it. Let the reader judge; TMLR does not score novelty. It studies RTK specifically and reaches a compatible conclusion by a paired provider-billed method (a decomposition-of-the-mean); our contribution is the estimator-efficiency result plus the analytic replay model that predicts the mean split.

option_B_feasibility.line: The taxonomy + methods paper ships now on existing data. Option B (an actual composition study) is the funded follow-up and needs ~265 runs/cell (not 12) across more task families; more SEEDS will NOT buy power at temperature 0.2 (E2 seeds collapse to ~2-3 distinct trajectories per cell).
option_B_feasibility.precise_power_target: To resolve the generation-offset hypothesis (detect ~973 GT at observed SD ~3150, 80% power) needs ~165 runs/cell. NOTE: a paired within-(task,seed) design does NOT reduce variance for this contrast (paired SD 4749 > pooled 3154; t=0.71), so pairing is not the lever here - raw replication is. This is Option B's concrete, quantified target, not a vague 'more pairs'.
option_B_feasibility.cost_note: Compute is the binding constraint (A40 + vLLM, self-hosted). Breadth is resourcing, not a design flaw; D-prime does not depend on it.

honest_paper_framing.verdict: After five retracted empirical headlines, the data do not support ANY token-outcome finding at n=12 beyond the two near-tautological direct effects. The honest paper is a taxonomy + accounting framework + methodological pilot - close to the original abstract, which was more accurate than anything that replaced it.
what_the_paper_claims_and_can_support: Taxonomy of token-efficiency interventions by intervention point (Categories 1-5).
Budget-recurrence accounting framework (Eqs 4-8) as a conceptual tool (NOT validated as predictive at this n).
C2 commensurability argument (published evaluations are not directly comparable).

A pilot 2x2 protocol that DEMONSTRATES the evaluation method and reports what it costs to run properly: cumulative-token SD ~= mean, so ~265 runs/cell needed to detect even the model-predicted RTK effect; 72% of E2 runs process-degenerate (arm-loaded 78/67, collider); seeds buy ~1 extra trajectory not 4; the interaction is a null and is underpowered for ALL token outcomes, not just the interaction.

Two direct-mechanical effects that ARE detectable (reported as such, not as compositional findings): RTK reduces tool output (-803, CI [-1539,-145]); compaction reduces cumulative PT (-23,495, CI [-45,964,-2,603]).
E1 confirmatory result reproduces byte-exact from raw traces (reproducibility).
honest_paper_framing.what_the_paper_must_NOT_claim: Any RTK effect on PT/GT; any interaction/composition effect; the 3.05x calibration; the generation-offset mechanism; a validated predictive model; a normalisation precision gain.

editor_criticism_response_map.1_exposition_spec_list: Phase 6 rewrite: replace the 6.3 setting-list with a what/why narrative anchored on the accounting framework and the protocol.
editor_criticism_response_map.2_composition_more_extensive_across_task: Conceded and reframed: at n=12 the composition question is unanswerable (all interactions null, wide CIs). The pilot's job is to demonstrate the protocol and quantify the sample size a real composition study needs (~265/cell), across more task families. This turns the weakness into the methodological contribution.
editor_criticism_response_map.3_statistical_relevance_success_split_or: Addressed honestly and turned into a result: per-turn normalisation (the editor's remedy) does NOT help here (relative precision unchanged, CI/|est| 16.8 vs 17.0; turns ~constant). The real problem is cumulative-token dispersion (SD ~= mean); we quantify it and the required sample size. Success-stratification is a collider (descriptive only).
editor_criticism_response_map.4_conclusions_significance: Reframed from an empirical headline to a methodological one: the significance is the framework + the quantified cost of doing this evaluation correctly (variance, degeneracy, seed-futility, required n), plus an honest null on the composition question. TMLR judges whether claims are supported; this version's claims are.

next_steps_needing_user_go_ahead: DECISION for the user: accept the methods/protocol + taxonomy framing (recommended, the only version the data support), or pursue Option B (scale to ~265/cell across task families) before writing an empirical composition claim.
DO NOT run the compaction Eq-2/3 test: it has the same structure (precise prediction vs an unmeasurable cumulative-token target) and would produce a sixth retraction.

Phase 6 (on user go-ahead): create paper_for_TMLR/ (copy from frozen paper_for_AI_review_journal, keep original frozen), rewrite as taxonomy + accounting framework + methodological pilot; integrate corpus fixes (SAC->cost-of-pass, ACON/AgentDiet/LightThinker++, cite 2607.12161 with date).
